prompt: Writing a custom Solr doc transformer requires two Java classes. Name the two base classes I extend (one for the factory, one for the per-doc work). Comma-separated.
If my custom DocTransformer reads from the Solr index (e.g., to fetch related docs), what method must I override to return true so context.getSearcher() is available? Just the method name.
notes: needsSolrIndexSearcher() default false; override to true if using searcher

prompt: My DocTransformer needs to read the parent_id_s field on each doc, but users won't always put it in fl. What method do I override to ensure it's loaded? Just the method name.
notes: getExtraRequestFields() declares fields the transformer needs that may not be in user fl

prompt: Why should my DocTransformer's getName() return the user-provided field name (passed to factory.create) rather than a hardcoded string? One sentence.
notes: Lets fl=*,a:[X],b:[X] use same factory with two distinct result names

prompt: Write the solrconfig.xml fragment that registers a TransformerFactory class com.example.MyFactory under the user-facing name 'myT'. One element.

I'm writing a custom transformer that returns children of the current parent doc by leveraging block-join. What Lucene Query class scopes the search to ONE specific parent's children (given the parent's docid)? Just the class name.
notes: ParentChildrenBlockJoinQuery(parentBitSet, childQuery, parentDocId) — block-join scope to one parent

prompt: Is it safe to keep a mutable List<String> field in my DocTransformer instance that accumulates ids across doc transformations within one request? One sentence answer.
notes: DocTransformer instances may be reused; keep state in req.getContext() instead

prompt: In SolrCloud, where does a DocTransformer's transform() actually execute — on each shard, or only on the coordinator? One word + one short sentence why this matters.
notes: Transformer runs on coordinator after merge; only the rows-bounded final result is transformed

prompt: I have a multivalued string field taxonomy_path_ss with many values per doc. I want a custom transformer that retains only values starting with one of a configurable list of prefixes. Sketch the transform() body in 3-5 lines (pseudocode is fine).
notes: Read field, filter by prefix list, setField with filtered list
